set.body: Reproduce the source327eda historical LWU cohorts (100 each at SNR1/.5, seeds111/112) with unchanged budgets/weak-SD/policy. Add bounded test-only per-voxel diagnostic records and terminal jet audits, retain exact refused input literals, distinguish weak/boundary/curvature/budget failure without assuming all refusals are rho-weak. Correct stale budget/refusal labels. Both JVM/JS diagnostics must reproduce the existing admission totals; archive exact source/runtime/provider/raw identities and independently analyze evidence. No fresh streams, production numerical edits, tolerance/budget tuning, 100k launch or parent closure.
set.title: PHRF-21: Diagnose frozen LWU refusal categories
